title: Moonlight 15 — Two Silver Coins
description: Weed hides his delight, accepts the instructor’s unusual quest, and receives two silver coins before taking a single step.
script:
story 2
variable rare = false hidden
variable promise = false hidden
label opening
scene hall
ambience hall
show Hyun happy left
show Instructor neutral right
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
look Instructor Hyun
I: 教官还在等我说话。我差一点就笑了。
camera medium Hyun
I: 这个任务，可能很特别。
choice lucky
option friend "谁会和教官这么好？" -> friend ; rare = true
option training "谁会在这里练习三个星期？" -> training
label friend
I: 别人忙着去外面。我却来这里，和教官一起吃午饭。
goto conditions
label training
I: 别人学会了就走。我却对着木头人，练习了三个星期。
label conditions
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
I: 要在这个城市开始，还要和教官这么好。
I: 要认真练习用剑，却没有学过雕刻。
I: 最后，还得正好和他一起说雕刻不好。
camera medium Hyun
express Hyun excited
I: 这么多条件，我全都做到了。
I: 更好的是，这只是个E级任务。
I: 我身上的钱快没有了，面包也不多了。
choice face
option calm "先别笑，认真一点。" -> calm
option hungry "先别想面包，看着教官。" -> hungry
label calm
express Hyun neutral
I: 我不笑了，认认真真地想这个问题。
goto accept
label hungry
look Hyun Instructor
I: 我不再想面包，认真地看教官。
label accept
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
react Hyun nod
Hyun [determined]: 能帮您做这个任务，是我的荣幸。
Hyun [skeptical]: 虽然我不相信，真的有人能把月光做成东西。
Hyun [determined]: 不过，我会去问清楚。
camera listener Instructor over 0.65
express Instructor happy
sound chime
I: 我接受了任务。
Instructor [happy]: 谢谢你，韦德。这个任务就给你了。
choice vow
option truth "我会把事情问明白。" -> truth ; promise = true
option report "我会回来跟您说。" -> report
label truth
Hyun [determined]: 我会把事情问明白，再来跟您说。
goto payment
label report
Hyun [happy]: 等我问到了，就回来跟您说。
label payment
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
Instructor [neutral]: 先拿着这些钱。
camera medium Hyun
express Hyun surprised
I: 教官给了我两枚银币。
I: 还没出门，钱已经到了手里。
express Hyun excited
I: 我手里有了钱，心里一下子放心了。
choice money
option thanks "好好说声谢谢。" -> thanks
option careful "先把钱收好。" -> careful
label thanks
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
Hyun [happy]: 谢谢您，教官。
goto advice
label careful
I: 我小心地把钱收起来。现在，钱就在我这里了。
label advice
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
Instructor [curious]: 你先去一个地方。
Instructor [neutral]: 去雕刻店，问问那边的人。
Hyun [curious]: 就是卖雕刻的店，对吗？
Instructor [happy]: 对，先去那里问一下。
react Hyun nod
Hyun [determined]: 好，我知道了。
if rare == true -> friendReturn else trainingReturn
label friendReturn
camera medium Hyun
I: 原来，和教官一起吃午饭，还能得到这样的任务。
goto promiseReturn
label trainingReturn
camera medium Hyun
I: 三个星期对着木头人，现在终于有了新的任务。
label promiseReturn
if promise == true -> truthReturn else reportReturn
label truthReturn
I: 钱到手了。不过，说过要问明白的事，也得去做。
goto ending
label reportReturn
I: 钱到手了。不过，我还得回来，把结果跟教官说。
label ending
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
look Hyun Instructor
I: 两枚银币，一个任务。现在，该去雕刻店了。
end

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Instructor.name: 教官 · Instructor
Instructor.provenance: Original fictional Training Hall instructor, shared polished SVG character; not official artwork.

Dummy.name: 稻草人 · Training dummy
Dummy.provenance: Original hand-authored vector straw training dummy rendered to transparent WebP. Inanimate standalone stage character. Paired choreography moves its whole body; no human facial or limb rig.

Watcher.name: 旁边的人 · Onlooker
Watcher.provenance: Original fictional passing player for LMS episode 7; shared polished SVG rig, not official art.

Pluto.name: 普鲁托 · Pluto
Pluto.provenance: Original fictional Pluto from the supplied Moonlight Sculptor scene. Polished SVG with silver and gold tunic styling; the source's plate armor is described, not a new articulated armor model. Not official artwork.

sources: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1, Chapter 2, supplied EPUB. From Weed’s recognition of the rare quest conditions through acceptance, two silver coins as advance payment, and advice to visit the sculpture shop. Stops before the bread-price calculation. Brief replies elaborate the existing exchange without changing source events.

教官还在等我说话。我差一点就笑了。.english: The instructor is still waiting for me to speak. I almost laugh.
教官还在等我说话。我差一点就笑了。.pinyin: jiào guān hái zài děng wǒ shuō huà 。 wǒ chà yì diǎn jiù xiào le 。

这个任务，可能很特别。.english: This quest may be very unusual.
这个任务，可能很特别。.pinyin: zhè ge rèn wu ， kě néng hěn tè bié 。

谁会和教官这么好？.english: Who would get along this well with the instructor?
谁会和教官这么好？.pinyin: shuí huì hé jiào guān zhè me hǎo ？

谁会在这里练习三个星期？.english: Who would practice here for three weeks?
谁会在这里练习三个星期？.pinyin: shuí huì zài zhè lǐ liàn xí sān gè xīng qī ？

别人忙着去外面。我却来这里，和教官一起吃午饭。.english: Others are busy heading outside. I come here instead and eat lunch with the instructor.
别人忙着去外面。我却来这里，和教官一起吃午饭。.pinyin: bié rén máng zhe qù wài miàn 。 wǒ què lái zhè lǐ ， hé jiào guān yì qǐ chī wǔ fàn 。

别人学会了就走。我却对着木头人，练习了三个星期。.english: Others learn a skill and leave. I have spent three weeks practicing against a wooden dummy.
别人学会了就走。我却对着木头人，练习了三个星期。.pinyin: bié rén xué huì le jiù zǒu 。 wǒ què duì zhe mù tou rén ， liàn xí le sān gè xīng qī 。

要在这个城市开始，还要和教官这么好。.english: You have to start in this city and get along this well with the instructor.
要在这个城市开始，还要和教官这么好。.pinyin: yào zài zhè ge chéng shì kāi shǐ ， hái yào hé jiào guān zhè me hǎo 。

要认真练习用剑，却没有学过雕刻。.english: You must practice swordsmanship seriously, yet never have learned sculpting.
要认真练习用剑，却没有学过雕刻。.pinyin: yào rèn zhēn liàn xí yòng jiàn ， què méi yǒu xué guò diāo kè 。

最后，还得正好和他一起说雕刻不好。.english: Finally, you must happen to join him in saying that sculpting is no good.
最后，还得正好和他一起说雕刻不好。.pinyin: zuì hòu ， hái děi zhèng hǎo hé tā yì qǐ shuō diāo kè bù hǎo 。

这么多条件，我全都做到了。.english: So many conditions, and I have met every one.
这么多条件，我全都做到了。.pinyin: zhè me duō tiáo jiàn ， wǒ quán dōu zuò dào le 。

更好的是，这只是个E级任务。.english: Even better, this is only an E-rank quest.
更好的是，这只是个E级任务。.pinyin: gèng hǎo de shì ， zhè zhǐ shì gè E jí rèn wu 。

我身上的钱快没有了，面包也不多了。.english: The money I have is almost gone, and my bread is running low too.
我身上的钱快没有了，面包也不多了。.pinyin: wǒ shēn shàng de qián kuài méi yǒu le ， miàn bāo yě bù duō le 。

先别笑，认真一点。.english: Don't smile yet. Look a little more serious.
先别笑，认真一点。.pinyin: xiān bié xiào ， rèn zhēn yì diǎn 。

先别想面包，看着教官。.english: Stop thinking about bread for now. Look at the instructor.

interlinear.gloss: Stop thinking about bread for now,

先别想面包，看着教官。.pinyin: xiān bié xiǎng miàn bāo ， kàn zhe jiào guān 。

我不笑了，认认真真地想这个问题。.english: I stop smiling and consider the question very seriously.
我不笑了，认认真真地想这个问题。.pinyin: wǒ bú xiào le ， rèn rèn zhēn zhēn de xiǎng zhè ge wèn tí 。

我不再想面包，认真地看教官。.english: I stop thinking about bread and look attentively at the instructor.
我不再想面包，认真地看教官。.pinyin: wǒ bú zài xiǎng miàn bāo ， rèn zhēn de kàn jiào guān 。

能帮您做这个任务，是我的荣幸。.english: It is my honor to help you with this quest.
能帮您做这个任务，是我的荣幸。.pinyin: néng bāng nín zuò zhè ge rèn wu ， shì wǒ de róng xìng 。

虽然我不相信，真的有人能把月光做成东西。.english: Although I don't believe anyone can really make something out of moonlight.
虽然我不相信，真的有人能把月光做成东西。.pinyin: suī rán wǒ bù xiāng xìn ， zhēn de yǒu rén néng bǎ yuè guāng zuò chéng dōng xī 。

不过，我会去问清楚。.english: Still, I will go and find out for certain.

interlinear.gloss: go and find out for certain.

不过，我会去问清楚。.pinyin: bú guò ， wǒ huì qù wèn qīng chǔ 。

我接受了任务。.pinyin: wǒ jiē shòu le rèn wu 。

谢谢你，韦德。这个任务就给你了。.english: Thank you, Weed. The quest is yours now.
谢谢你，韦德。这个任务就给你了。.pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ ， wéi dé 。 zhè ge rèn wu jiù gěi nǐ le 。

我会把事情问明白。.english: I will get to the bottom of this.

interlinear.gloss: get to the bottom of it.

我会把事情问明白。.pinyin: wǒ huì bǎ shì qing wèn míng bai 。

我会回来跟您说。.english: I will come back and tell you.
我会回来跟您说。.pinyin: wǒ huì huí lái gēn nín shuō 。

我会把事情问明白，再来跟您说。.english: I will get to the bottom of this, then come back and tell you.

interlinear.gloss: get to the bottom of it,

我会把事情问明白，再来跟您说。.pinyin: wǒ huì bǎ shì qing wèn míng bai ， zài lái gēn nín shuō 。

等我问到了，就回来跟您说。.english: Once I have found out, I will come back and tell you.
等我问到了，就回来跟您说。.pinyin: děng wǒ wèn dào le ， jiù huí lái gēn nín shuō 。

先拿着这些钱。.pinyin: xiān ná zhe zhè xiē qián 。

教官给了我两枚银币。.english: The instructor gives me two silver coins.
教官给了我两枚银币。.pinyin: jiào guān gěi le wǒ liǎng méi yín bì 。

还没出门，钱已经到了手里。.english: Before I have even gone out, the money is already in my hands.

interlinear.gloss: Before I have even gone out,

还没出门，钱已经到了手里。.pinyin: hái méi chū mén ， qián yǐ jīng dào le shǒu lǐ 。

我手里有了钱，心里一下子放心了。.english: With money in my hands, I feel relieved all at once.
我手里有了钱，心里一下子放心了。.pinyin: wǒ shǒu lǐ yǒu le qián ， xīn lǐ yí xià zi fàng xīn le 。

好好说声谢谢。.pinyin: hǎo hao shuō shēng xiè xiè 。

先把钱收好。.english: Put the money away safely first.

我小心地把钱收起来。现在，钱就在我这里了。.english: I carefully put the money away. Now it is right here with me.
我小心地把钱收起来。现在，钱就在我这里了。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎo xīn de bǎ qián shōu qǐ lái 。 xiàn zài ， qián jiù zài wǒ zhè lǐ le 。

你先去一个地方。.english: There is somewhere you should go first.
你先去一个地方。.pinyin: nǐ xiān qù yí gè dì fāng 。

去雕刻店，问问那边的人。.english: Go to the sculpture shop and ask the people there.
去雕刻店，问问那边的人。.pinyin: qù diāo kè diàn ， wèn wèn nà biān de rén 。

就是卖雕刻的店，对吗？.english: You mean the shop that sells sculptures, right?
就是卖雕刻的店，对吗？.pinyin: jiù shì mài diāo kè de diàn ， duì ma ？

对，先去那里问一下。.english: Yes. Go there first and ask around.
对，先去那里问一下。.pinyin: duì ， xiān qù nà lǐ wèn yí xià 。

原来，和教官一起吃午饭，还能得到这样的任务。.english: So eating lunch with the instructor can even get you a quest like this.
原来，和教官一起吃午饭，还能得到这样的任务。.pinyin: yuán lái ， hé jiào guān yì qǐ chī wǔ fàn ， hái néng dé dào zhè yàng de rèn wu 。

三个星期对着木头人，现在终于有了新的任务。.english: After three weeks facing a wooden dummy, I finally have a new quest.
三个星期对着木头人，现在终于有了新的任务。.pinyin: sān gè xīng qī duì zhe mù tou rén ， xiàn zài zhōng yú yǒu le xīn de rèn wu 。

钱到手了。不过，说过要问明白的事，也得去做。.english: The money is in my hands. But I still have to do what I said: get to the bottom of this.

interlinear.gloss: The money is in my hands.
I would get to the bottom of this,
interlinear.pinyin: yào wèn míng bai de shì ，

钱到手了。不过，说过要问明白的事，也得去做。.pinyin: qián dào shǒu le 。 bú guò ， shuō guò yào wèn míng bai de shì ， yě děi qù zuò 。

钱到手了。不过，我还得回来，把结果跟教官说。.english: The money is in my hands. But I still have to return and tell the instructor what I find out.

interlinear.gloss: The money is in my hands.

钱到手了。不过，我还得回来，把结果跟教官说。.pinyin: qián dào shǒu le 。 bú guò ， wǒ hái děi huí lái ， bǎ jié guǒ gēn jiào guān shuō 。

两枚银币，一个任务。现在，该去雕刻店了。.english: Two silver coins, one quest. Now it is time to go to the sculpture shop.
两枚银币，一个任务。现在，该去雕刻店了。.pinyin: liǎng méi yín bì ， yí gè rèn wu 。 xiàn zài ， gāi qù diāo kè diàn le 。
